issues.description: 500 Internal Server Error - the step-7c page is failing to load data from the API, causing the screen to be permanently stuck in a skeleton/loading state with no furniture items, no room image, and no Continue button rendered
issues.root_cause: Two 500 errors are logged: 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500 (Internal Server Error)'. The step-7c page is calling an API endpoint (likely /api/detect or similar pre_detection_result endpoint) that is returning 500, so the component never receives furniture data and stays in loading skeleton state indefinitely.

issues.description: Duplicate import of useEffect and useState in step-3/page.tsx causes a module build failure, which triggers a full page reload loop and hydration errors across the entire app, potentially affecting step-7c rendering
issues.root_cause: The file has two import lines from 'react': line 2 imports { useState, useEffect } and line 4 imports { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState }, causing 'the name useEffect/useState is defined multiple times' compile error.

fixes.old_str:
"use client"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Removes the duplicate import lines. The original file had two separate react imports (one on line 2 with useState/useEffect and one on line 4 with all four hooks), causing a build-breaking duplicate identifier error. Consolidating into one import line fixes the compilation error and stops the hydration error cascade.
